Typhoon Bavi (2026): Rapid Report

Lincole Jiang, Majd Abid, Lawrence Chillrud, G. Brooke Anderson, Robbie M. Parks

2026-10-23

Summary

Data status: Provisional — not yet reanalyzed (PROVISIONAL)

Typhoon Bavi (2026) was active from 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-14 18:00:00 UTC. Based on IBTrACS data obtained 10/23/2026, 41,910,931 people experienced tropical cyclone-force (>= 17.49 m/s) winds and 1,635,021 people experienced hurricane-force (>= 32.90 m/s) winds across United States of America, China, Japan. No areas experienced Category 5 winds.

Table 1: Population exposed by country and storm intensity
